full_judgment: 8. Mr. Ranadhir Sen, the learned Counsel for the appellants, contend that the trial Court as well as the High Court Division fell in grave error in deciding the question of title of the plaintiffs on the basis of the Khatian Ext 6, wrongly described as the CS Khatian. He has read out several passages from the Introduction to the Assam Land Revenue Manual, Volume I, Fifth Edition, Shillong Printed at the Assam Government Press 1931, in support of his contention that there is no presumption with regard to Ext 6. It is contended that though there had been several experimental surveys in Sylhet area the record of right had never been finally published.
